title: Multi-Auth System
description: Build a multi-authentication system that supports API key auth for v1 routes, JWT auth for v2 routes, and a combined auth chain that accepts either method.

steps.title: API key auth on v1 routes
steps.description: Create GET /api/v1/resource that authenticates using x-api-key header. Return 200 with data for valid keys and 401 for invalid or missing keys.
hints: Define a valid API key: const API_KEY = 'secret-v1-key'
Check req.headers['x-api-key'] against the valid key
Return 401 if missing or invalid, 200 with resource data if valid

steps.title: JWT auth on v2 routes
steps.description: Create GET /api/v2/resource that authenticates using a JWT Bearer token in the Authorization header. Return 200 with data for valid tokens and 401 for invalid.
hints: Parse the Bearer token from the Authorization header
Verify the JWT signature and expiration
Return resource data with the decoded user info for valid tokens

steps.title: Route-level auth selection middleware
steps.description: Create reusable middleware functions: `apiKeyAuth` for API key auth and `jwtAuth` for JWT auth. Apply them selectively to v1 and v2 routes.
hints: Create apiKeyAuth middleware: checks x-api-key header
Create jwtAuth middleware: checks Bearer token in Authorization header
Apply apiKeyAuth to /api/v1/* routes and jwtAuth to /api/v2/* routes

steps.title: Mixed endpoints with different auth methods
steps.description: Create multiple endpoints that use different auth methods depending on the path: /api/v1/items (API key) and /api/v2/users (JWT).
hints: Apply apiKeyAuth middleware to v1 routes like /api/v1/items
Apply jwtAuth middleware to v2 routes like /api/v2/users
Each middleware should only affect its designated routes

steps.title: Auth chain (API key OR JWT)
steps.description: Create a combined `authChain` middleware that accepts either API key OR JWT. If either authentication method succeeds, allow the request. Return 401 only if both fail.
hints: Create authChain middleware that tries API key first, then JWT
If API key is valid, set req.authMethod = 'apikey' and proceed
If JWT is valid, set req.authMethod = 'jwt' and proceed
